verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only an official Sumsub MCP server that lets external AI agents call Sumsub operations. That is the server role. Nothing shows Sumsub itself, or its Summy AI features, connecting to or consuming tools from third-party MCP servers. Server-side MCP support does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
